message.content:
The Declaration of Independence was signed by 56 delegates representing the thirteen American colonies. The signers were:

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | Thomas McKean, George Read, Caesar Rodney |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Morton, George Clymer, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Morris, George Taylor, James Smith, George Ross, John Penn, William Allen, John Penn (the younger), John Penn (the elder) |
| **New Jersey** | William Livingston, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark, John Hart, William Livingston (again), John Witherspoon (again) |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott, Oliver Wolcott Jr. |
| **Massachusetts** | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Hancock (again), John Hancock (again) |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll (again) |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, John Rutledge |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, Richard Henry Lee, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Harrison, Thomas Jefferson (again), Patrick Henry |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris, Robert R. Livingston, John Jay, William Floyd (again) |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn (the younger) |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Samuel J. Potter |

These individuals signed the document on August 2, 1776, and it was officially adopted on July 4, 1776.
